item.title: Data Protection Commission fines Google €403M over processing of location data
item.description:
📝 Location data can bring both benefits and harms to individuals. The information processed can include personal data such as browsing history, search history, and location data. item.title: I don't want to read what you didn't write
item.description:

item.title: Spymarks, Not Watermarks
item.description:
📝 A spymark is a hidden signal that makes your work traceable without your knowledge or consent. This signal can encode database identifiers that map to your identity. That last usage obscures the privacy risk that some forms of modern “watermarks” have become.
🔗 Read more: https://brand.io/article/spymarks/
